# orion reveal

Select cards or groups in the app and zoom the canvas to them

```sh
orion reveal [options] [ids...]
```

| Argument        | Description                           |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `[ids...]`      | Item or group ids to reveal           |
| `--select-only` | Select them without moving the camera |
| `--json`        | Print JSON                            |
